name: Regime-dependent signal
description: Signal active only in high_rate regime (first half of series, key_rate≈18.0%); zero in low_rate regime (second half, key_rate≈8.0%). Lag 7, r_high=-0.5 on returns.

data_generating_process.regime: first half high_rate, second half low_rate
data_generating_process.key_rate_pct: 18.0 in high_rate else 8.0, plus N(0, 0.5) noise
data_generating_process.market_return: r * z(news[t-7]) + sqrt(1-r^2) * z(eps), r=r_high in high_rate else 0, scaled by 0.01

expected_method_behavior.regime_aware_method: should detect strong signal in high_rate, reject in low_rate
expected_method_behavior.regime_blind_method: should see diluted signal (~-0.25), borderline confirm
expected_method_behavior.comment: Distinguishes methods that handle regime conditioning from those that don't. Calibration dataset.
